profile.entities: Olatech Solutions Limited; Olatech Digital Solutions Private Limited (85% owned)

deepdive.sec: Telecom & Data Center Enablement & Digital Transformation Services

bull_bear.body: Prioritizing inventory for AMC, expanding digital sales team (Hyderabad, Noida, Chennai), funding R&D for AI products, and maintaining liquidity for Exclusion server inventory. No dividend or buyback announced.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Customer concentration risk (top 5 clients ~25-30% revenue); receivables rising to 6.5 Cr (110+ days); Exclusion server revenue delayed due to India-China trade tensions; margin compression from low-margin hardware sales; execution risk in scaling 10x enterprise digital business
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, aggressive, and transparent — management openly acknowledges low-margin business for top-line growth, highlights strategic separation of digital arm, and sets bold FY26 targets with clear order book backing. Tone is entrepreneurial, not corporate.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: The 45 Cr order is not just a project — it’s a template for bundled telecom contracts (software + hardware + 10-year AMC + managed services) that Olatech can replicate; influencer marketing is not just a service but a productized platform with IP (Earnin.me) and regional sales teams; Exclusion server distribution is a hidden lever — if India-China trade eases, this could become a 50 Cr+ business with minimal capex
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Hardware AMC & EMS: 15 Cr revenue (FY25), targeting 30 Cr in FY26 (30-40% growth); Software & Products: 4.5 Cr revenue (FY25), targeting 30 Cr in FY26 (driven by 45 Cr order + new AI tools); Enterprise Digital: 1.29 Cr revenue (FY25), targeting 10 Cr in FY26 (via Olatech Digital Solutions); Exclusion Server Distribution: 0 in FY25, targeting 5 Cr in FY26 (H1 start); Influencer Marketing: 0 in FY25, targeting 5-6 Cr in FY26
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: Hardware AMC: 25-30% EBITDA; Software/Products: 40-45% EBITDA; Influencer Marketing: 35-40% EBITDA; Exclusion Server: 10-15% EBITDA; overall PAT margin target 20% — low-margin Exclusion sales will pressure overall margin but boost top-line credibility for tenders
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: 50 Cr+ in FY26 (2.4x FY25); margin: target 20% PAT margin; order inflow: 45 Cr order (50% to be billed in FY26); capex/commissioning: office purchase completed (Rupa Solitaire); no new capex planned beyond inventory and branch expansion
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: 35 Cr total (incl. 45 Cr mega order — 50% to be billed in FY26, rest over 10 years; enterprise digital: 3 Cr; software: 15 Cr+; hardware AMC: 10 Cr+; Exclusion server: 5 Cr pipeline)
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Exclusion server distribution (India-China trade normalization could unlock 5-10x revenue); AI product suite (15 products in pipeline, 7-8 launched); e-commerce portal for spare parts (future monetization); geographic expansion to 10 cities (Ahmedabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida) enabling local service delivery
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Olatech transformed from a modest software services firm to a diversified tech integrator with a 35-crore order book, driven by a landmark 45-crore bundled telecom deal spanning software, hardware, AMC, and managed services — this shifts the business model from project-based to recurring revenue, with enterprise digital and Exclusion server distribution now acting as high-growth levers.
